text: Governor Harrow. You have an appointment, I trust? No? Then be brief.
Port Meridian runs on order, captain. And on taxes. Mostly taxes.
Ah. A visitor. How... unexpected.
You. You've cost me everything. Speak, if you must, and then get out of my house.
My dear captain. The Court remembers its friends. Do sit.
I know where my ledger went, captain. Every page of it.
My door is always open to you, captain. Port Meridian remembers its friends.
Four relics, I hear. Or is it five? People talk, and I listen. Sit down, captain.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.

options.label: Is there something you need done?
You wanted to talk about the relics?
I'll take your bargain. (Permanent: join the Lantern Court's deal)

text: The jewel of the Tidewatch's possessions. Paved streets, a proper chapel, a mansion fit for a governor.
Merchants pay their dues here, and in return they don't get robbed. Mostly. You'll find Merchant Abernathy in the plaza.
Twenty years climbing the Crown's ladder, captain. One must be patient, and generous to the right people, and forgetful about the wrong ones.
I was given the post by people who see further than the Crown. Leave it there.
A society of patient people. We collect the past, captain. The First Tide knew things about the sea the Crown never will.
When the gate opens, someone must hold the door. Better us than pirates. Better us than the drowned.
A society you've made an enemy of. Patient people have long memories.
